why_ai: Unlicensed SaaS, though entrenched systems of record holding workforce history resist replacement by 2031.
why_clarity: Payroll, records and compliance configurations are defined and checked every cycle.
why_digital: Employment records in, software and reports out, sold remotely to employers.

why_ai: Eligibility file reconciliation is among the most mechanical tasks software can perform.
why_clarity: Carrier and employer records either match or diverge, checkable on every file exchange.
why_digital: Electronic eligibility files compared and corrected entirely in software.

why_ai: Equity and market positioning are computable at decision time, though transparency law adds legal stakes.
why_clarity: Equity regressions and market bands are standard methods applied to every pay decision.
why_digital: Pay and market data analysed and delivered within compensation software.

why_ai: Rule-change monitoring and carrier file reconciliation are both mechanical tasks for software.
why_clarity: Entitlements follow written statutes and plan rules applied across every employee.
why_digital: Statutes, plan documents and carrier files processed entirely on screens.

why_ai: Assembling workforce data is mechanical, while classification exposure needs some legal judgment.
why_clarity: Headcount is countable once systems are joined, but classification tests are fact-specific.
why_digital: Procurement, payroll and access data joined entirely in software.

why_ai: Repetitive employee questions answered from their own record are ideal for an AI assistant.
why_clarity: Each question has a correct answer in the employee's record or policy.
why_digital: Questions and answers flow through portals and chat, entirely online.

why_ai: Scheduling, hours and accrual visibility are mechanical calculations delivered by apps.
why_clarity: Hours worked and pay owed are exact and verifiable against punches.
why_digital: Time clock data processed and shown to workers on mobile apps.

why_ai: Job architecture is inferable from titles, pay and reporting data, shrinking consultant workshops.
why_clarity: Each employer's job structure is designed anew, with no single right architecture.
why_digital: Spreadsheets and HR data drive the work, with some workshops held on site.

why_ai: The ADA interactive process requires an accountable person's good-faith judgment on each accommodation.
why_clarity: Statutory eligibility tests and clocks are written down, though accommodations vary by case.
why_digital: Medical certifications and correspondence handled as documents in case software.

why_ai: Monitoring a bounded corpus of published ordinances is a well-posed detection task for AI.
why_clarity: Each ordinance states rules that a configuration either matches or misses.
why_digital: Published ordinances in, rule configurations out, entirely in software.

why_ai: Longitudinal employment records are clean data for ML diagnosis with no licence involved.
why_clarity: Whether a diagnosed condition caused resignations is confirmed only months later.
why_digital: HR records analysed and delivered as dashboards within software.
